_doc: Skyloom trailer EDL -- documented example (it validates: python3 conform.py edl.example.json --check).
Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored everywhere. Everything else is validated STRICTLY:
unknown keys, wrong types and out-of-range values are errors, and all errors are reported at once.
All times are timeline seconds (0 .. duration) EXCEPT clip-level keyframes, which are CLIP-RELATIVE
(0 = the clip's t0). Pixel values (letterbox, shake) are authored at the EDL 'size' and scale with --preview-scale.
_clips_doc: clips: sorted by t0, non-overlapping ([t0, t1) intervals; a gap renders black).
id        unique name (used in logs / the missing-frame report)
src       directory of NNNNN.jpg frames (+ optional NNNNN.dom.png RGBA UI overlays, alpha-composited over the
jpg of the same index), or a single image file. Relative paths resolve against this file's folder.
A source smaller than 'size' (the 960x540 drafts) is upscaled with Lanczos4 + a light unsharp mask.
in        source frame index shown at t0 (float ok)
src_fps   source frame rate (default = fps)
speed     1.0, or [[t, speed], ...] keys (clip-relative, linear between keys, held outside). The speed curve is
INTEGRATED to a source position, so a ramp never jumps. Speed 0 = freeze, negative = reverse.
blend     false: fractional source positions use the nearest frame; true: blend the two neighbours
enabled   false drops the clip (its time renders black)
fx        zoom [z0, z1] (1.0..8.0; eased in-out over the clip) + zoom_center [x, y] (0..1, the point that stays put)
exposure (stops, linear light)  contrast (1 = none; S about mid grey)  sat (1 = none)
temp (-1 cool .. 1 warm)  tint (-1 green .. 1 magenta)  lift (-0.25..0.25, raises/lowers blacks)
shake (px amplitude, deterministic 1.3-9 Hz; auto-overscan)  blur_radial (0..1 zoom blur)  flip (mirror)
Every scalar fx may also be keyframed: [[t, value], ...] (clip-relative).
trans_in  {type, dur, strength?, dir?, color?} -- how this clip comes in from the previous one:
cut; fade (cross-dissolve over [t0-dur/2, t0+dur/2]); dip_black / dip_white (to the colour at t0 and back);
flash (hard cut + additive white bloom peaking ON the cut, 2-frame pre-glow, decaying over dur);
whip (directional smear + slide + slight zoom across the cut; dir left|right|up|down);
glitch_warp (hyperspace: rush zoom, radial light streaks, chromatic split, glitch slices, white peak).
fade / whip / glitch_warp render BOTH clips inside the window: the outgoing clip keeps playing past its
t1 and the incoming one starts before its t0 -- the preflight lists the source frames each clip needs.

clips._note: a speed ramp: slow-mo into the boost, then punch back to 1.5x, with frame blending
a gap 28-60 renders black; atlas-ui carries NNNNN.dom.png UI overlays

_titles_doc: title_manifest: titles/manifest.json from the title renderer: sequences {dir, t0, t1, frames, fps, alpha, pattern}.
Frame k = round((t - t0) * fps) of each sequence is composited while 0 <= k < frames.
alpha true  -> overlay, alpha-over the graded picture (straight vs premultiplied is auto-detected per sequence
from the PNGs: a colour channel above alpha means straight; the preflight prints the result).
alpha false -> opaque plate (the end card): replaces the whole frame, ungraded, no letterbox bars.
titles_enabled false hides every title; titles_exclude lists sequence slugs to leave out.
_black_fades_doc: black: hard-black ranges [[t0, t1], ...] for the PICTURE layer (titles still composite over them).
fades: global picture fades {t0, t1, from, to (0 = black, 1 = full), curve: linear|smooth}; before t0 the
fade does nothing, after t1 it holds 'to'. Several fades multiply.
_global_doc: letterbox: px per bar at 'size' (0 = off; 60 = 2.0:1), or [[t, px], ...] keys on ABSOLUTE timeline seconds.
Bars are drawn last, over titles, except while an opaque plate is up.
grain 0..1 (animated luma grain, deterministic per frame; ~0.35 is subtle), grain_size 0.5..3 (px softness),
vignette 0..1 (0.35 = corners -14%), halation 0..1 (red-orange glow around bright highlights),
chromatic 0..1 (radial R/B split; 0.15 = 0.9 px at the corners).
grade (the house look, all optional): exposure, contrast, sat (default 0.97), temp, tint, lift -- same meaning as
clip fx, applied after them -- plus filmic 0..1.5 (gentle S + highlight shoulder; default 1), split 0..2
(teal shadows / warm highlights; default 0.5), shadow_tint / highlight_tint [r, g, b] directions,
black (output black floor, default 0) and white (output white, default 1 - 0.025 * filmic).
_audio_doc: audio: rendered by mix.py (cached by content hash next to the output). music (required) + an SFX stem from
sfx_events (an sfx.py events JSON, rendered via sfx.py) or sfx_wav (a pre-rendered stem; never overwritten).
music_gain_db / sfx_gain_db; duck = music-only dips [[t0, t1, db<0], ...] with an optional 4th element
'range' (default: static dip, 80 ms attack before t0, 350 ms release after t1) or 'sidechain' (the dip follows
the SFX envelope inside the range), or objects {t0, t1, db, mode, attack, release}; fade_out [t0, t1];
target_lufs (-14), ceiling_dbtp (-1), compressor {enabled, threshold_db, ratio, attack_ms, release_ms, knee_db};
mix_wav: use a finished mix as-is (skips mix.py).
